variants.label: Table + details
variants.notes: Filter tabs (All, Running, Failed, Stopped, Timers, Sockets), failed-service banner, dense table with state, start-at-boot switch, memory and CPU. Details panel on the right with actions, memory chart, recent log and dependencies.

variants.label: Cards by purpose
variants.notes: Failed services pinned on top with a plain-language hint and fixes. The rest as cards grouped by purpose (Web, Containers, System) with boot switch and quick actions.

variants.label: List + full detail
variants.notes: Narrow list on the left, the selected service takes the page: Overview, Logs, Unit file, Dependencies tabs. Unit edits go to an override file, shown as added lines.
